venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — the snaps
dek: Quarter. Clock. Who is on the field. What Faulkner or White is asking. Why it worked — or why it did not.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — Charles has not approved publish. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Put the tape on. First quarter, 8:49, Brown’s hitch. First quarter, 12:07, Coleman in the lane. That is Faulkner and White. The rest of the night is those two ideas.

offense.body:
First quarter, 12:00, first-and-10, Florida 6. Shotgun. One running back (Baugh), one tight end, three receivers. That is 11 personnel — three wide, one back, one tight end. They huddle, they line up, they give it to Baugh. He hits it for 9. Faulkner’s first answer is the run. Stretch the field so they cannot put eight in the box. Then hand it to the best player.

First quarter, 10:50, first-and-10, Florida 23. Same 11. Shotgun, two receivers to each side, tight end just off the tackle. Play clock in single digits — they are not in a hurry. Philo throws short right to Brown for 8. Hitch. Corner is sitting off. Easy throw. That is how this offense stays on schedule. Run Baugh. If they sit, throw it now.

First quarter, 9:14, second-and-12, Florida 32. Same 11. Philo just got dropped for two. They do not panic. Short left to Wilson. Catch at the 48. Nineteen yards. First down. Same idea as the hitch: get it out, stay on the field, then come back to the run.

First quarter, 8:49, first-and-10, FAU 49. Same 11. Shotgun. Baugh to Philo’s left. Three receivers to the field, one to the boundary — trips. Tight end is split out in that trips, not jammed on the tackle. FAU has two safeties high and the corners are 8 yards off. Faulkner is reading the numbers. If they load it, Baugh has the give. They do not. They sit. Philo rips the hitch to Brown. Official chart: caught at the 50. First man misses. Brown runs it 49. That is not a bomb. That is quick game after they refused the run. VB3 is the guy he wants in that window because he will make the first miss.

First quarter, 7:17, first-and-5, FAU 43. 11, shotgun. Baugh left, 18. The front clogs. He plants and bounces. Same run family as the first snap. The bounce is built in. If the end crashes, Baugh is already outside.

First quarter, 6:34, first-and-10, FAU 12. 11, shotgun. Three to the field, one to the boundary. They are in the red zone. Philo throws it now to Stockton on the right. Official chart: caught at the 11. Stockton finishes. Why it works: they already showed hitch to Brown. Same window. Different guy. He takes it in.

First quarter, 4:21, second-and-4, Florida 45. 11, shotgun. Brown takes it left for 14. Same picture as the hitch — they are so worried about him catching it that Faulkner hands him the run. Manufactured. Not a gadget they hid.

Second quarter, 13:22, second-and-6, Florida 29. 11, shotgun. FAU just scored. Safety is cheating the run because Baugh has been eating. Extra bodies stay in to protect. Abrams runs by everybody down the right sideline. 63 yards to the 8. Why it works: the go is earned. They sat for the run. He took the lid off.

Second quarter, 11:05, fourth-and-3, FAU 3. Shotgun. Nobody in the backfield. Five out. Faulkner emptied it so the ends have to declare. They climb the pocket. Contain is gone. Philo walks in. Why it works: the keep is live because of how he lined them up. If they stay home, he has five to throw to.

Second quarter, 4:05, first-and-10, FAU 12. Shotgun, Baugh. The front side clogs. He cuts backside. 12-yard score. Same bounce rule as the 18.

Second quarter, 2:51, second-and-3, FAU 7. 11, shotgun. Baugh to Philo’s left, tight end attached. He bounces outside the tackle, pad down, two arm tackles, dives. 7-yard score. Red zone, they know it is run. He still wins.

Third quarter, 13:59, third-and-2, Florida 33. 11, shotgun. Baugh left. Crease. 61 yards to the 6. Then 13:11, first-and-goal. Heavier look, puller, through the pile. 6-yard score. Faulkner said he would run it when the stadium knew. That series is the sentence.

Third quarter, 7:20, first-and-10, Florida 40. Same 11. They have been sitting for Baugh again. Philo goes over the top to Brown down the right. 33 yards to the 27. Same earned shot as Abrams. Then 4:29, first-and-10, FAU 10. Clark is the back. Linebackers are sitting for the run. Clark releases. Philo throws it now, short left. Official chart: caught at the 4. Clark drives it in. Why it works: they finally sat the linebackers. The back becomes the receiver.

Second quarter, 0:44, third-and-7, FAU 44. 11, shotgun. This one does not work. Philo throws it late. Sweeney sits and takes it. The rhythm throw is the offense. When he holds it, the window closes. That is the other side of hitch.

What the night is: 11, shotgun, Baugh until they sit, hitch, then the go. Empty when he wants the ends to climb.
bullets: 12:00 1st, 1st-and-10: 11, shotgun. Baugh for 9. First answer is the run.
8:49 1st, 1st-and-10 FAU 49: 11, trips, TE split out. They sit. Hitch to Brown. Missed tackle. 49.
6:34 1st, FAU 12: same 11. Short right to Stockton. He finishes.
13:22 2nd: they cheat the run. Max protect. Abrams, go, 63.
13:59 3rd: Baugh 61, then power at the 6. Run it when they know.
0:44 2nd: he holds it. Sweeney takes it. Late throw is the miss.

defense.body:
First quarter, 14:27, third-and-7, FAU 28. FAU in the shotgun, one back. Florida has four down, two linebackers, extra DB on the slot. Corners are off. Veltkamp throws hitch to Henry. Ten yards. Converted. That is the trade opening the night. White will not get beat deep. He will live with the five-yard throw if they tackle.

First quarter, 12:07, third-and-10, Florida 35. Shotgun. Trips to one side, one receiver the other way, back next to Veltkamp. White does not send the house. Four rush. Everybody else drops. Two safeties high. The ball comes out late. Coleman is sitting in the lane. He catches it at the Florida 5. Drive over. Why it works: make him hold it. Do not open a window with a blitz.

Second quarter, 13:55, first-and-goal, Florida 1. White packs the box. No bounce. You have to win this yard. Ervin still walks in. Why it does not work: the front was right. They lost the pile. Phone booth. That is a job, not a surprise call.

Second quarter, 6:52, third-and-7, Florida 7. FAU shotgun, 2x2, back offset. Florida four down, extra DB on the slot, safety in the end zone. Four rush again. Veltkamp feels it, leaves, dives the pylon. Watch the end. His job is stay outside and keep the quarterback in. He does not. Why it does not work: contain. Same rush plan as Coleman’s pick. Different job lost.

Second quarter, 4:01, first-and-10, FAU 25. First play after Baugh scored. Shotgun. Four rush. Heat up the middle. Veltkamp throws off his back foot. Johnson goes up and gets it at the FAU 30. Coleman is on the breakup. Why it works: same wait as 12:07. He held it. They took it.

Third quarter, 1:18, first-and-10, Florida 20. FAU shotgun, three wide, one back. Florida corners are still off — that has been the night. Valsin releases outside, stacks Flowers, wins the back line. Caught at the goal line. 20-yard score. Why it does not work: if you sit off all night to kill the deep ball, you have to win the fade when they throw it.

Fourth quarter, 6:45, fourth-and-1, Florida 1. FAU trying to punch it. Veltkamp keeps left. Bett gets there. Ball out at the 5. Myles Johnson falls on it at the 11. Why it works: the rush finally finishes. White has been waiting all night. This time the guy wins his one-on-one.

What the night is: four down, extra DB on the slot, rush four, no deep ball. Coleman and Johnson are that plan. The sloppy part is the hitch they agreed to live with, plus the pile, the edge, and the fade.

specials.body: First quarter, 2:06, fourth-and-4, FAU 35. They can go for it. They let Durkin try it from 53. Clean. 17–0. Florida never punts.

keys: 8:49 1st: 11, trips, TE split out. They sit. Hitch to Brown. That is the offense.
13:22 2nd: they cheat Baugh. Abrams, go. The shot is earned.
12:07 1st: four rush, late ball, Coleman. That is White.
They lose when the pile, the edge, or the fade loses. Campbell will throw hitch and run the quarterback.

nextWeek.look: They will go fast and throw hitch. Faulkner will still be 11 and Baugh. White will still rush four. The snaps that matter are the short throw and whether the end stays home.
